title: でこぼこトライアングル

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Glory to the warrior, glory! Glory to me, glory!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Even my speeches are more tantalizing than usual today. Oh, how I wish to share them with someone!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: La la laaa. ♪ Isn't that riiight, Ayabeee? ♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Move it. I'm trying to train.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: You're trying to say that you don't want me in front of you… but rather running beside you! I assume that's what you mean?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: How did you come to that conclusion?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Just leave me alone!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Good. I think I've gotten far enough a—agh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thump!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Eek!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh, I'm so, so sorry! It was my fault for zoning out!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Doto? Well, it doesn't look like you're hurt. I'm in a hurry—later.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? My leg won't move where I want it to…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Wha?! Our shoelaces are tangled!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Uwaaahhh?! H-how did that happen?! I-I'm really sorry!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ayabeee! Wherever might you beee? Let's aim to perform together at the La Scala in Milan!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Argh, she's caught up with me!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Don't worry—I'll untie us right away! Um, this goes… through here? And then… Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Uwaaah! I made it even worse! H-h-how did that happen?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …There's no time. We're going to have to escape together!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Right, left, right, left! Come on, we're picking up the pace!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: O-o-okay! One, two, one… twooo?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: You both are just like Don Carlo and Rodrigo! Oh my! If I were to join in, we could weave a brand-new tale!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The three of them end up running all around, getting more exercise than they would have from any regular training session.
